verdict.rationale: uv is a Python package and project manager CLI. A developer tool like this could plausibly ship an embedded AI assistant, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows any built-in assistant or task delegation. The llms.txt documentation index only helps external AI tools read the docs; it is not an assistant inside the product and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
